episodes.synopsis: The homeless and desperate Koushi has been offered a job! But after a bad first impression, Atena will need time to adjust to the idea of Koushi living at the Goddess’ Dorm.
episodes.title: Koushi Becomes a Dorm Mother / The Problem with Mineru and Frey

episodes.synopsis: How has Koushi managed to befriend the dorm residents so quickly? Atena think he’s super sus! But when a shopping trip goes awry, will she be able to accept his help?
episodes.title: The Problem with Kiriya and Serene / Atena Awakens

episodes.synopsis: Now that he’s settled into his new life, Koushi returns to school! Everyone wants to know where he’s been, but will Koushi’s childhood friend, Sutea, appreciate the truth?
episodes.title: Koushi, at a Loss / Koushi Goes Back to School

episodes.synopsis: Sutea meets the residents of the Goddess’ Dorm, with mixed results. Later, Koushi goes undercover at the college and lands in hot water.
episodes.title: A Childhood Friend Visits the Dorm / Koushi Goes Undercover at a Women's College

episodes.synopsis: It’s time for some fun in the sun during summer break, only Serene doesn’t seem too keen on the idea. Time to help out the dorm’s most mysterious member!
episodes.title: Serene the Shut-in / The Goddess Dormitory Goes on Vacation

episodes.synopsis: Koushi plays lifeguard on duty as the dorm’s beach vacation continues. Back at home, he takes a trip into the cosplay closet with Frey.
episodes.title: Sutea Ponders About the Sea / Koushi Makes His Cosplay Debut

episodes.synopsis: Koushi doesn’t have to wear a disguise for Seikan’s school festival, so that means he and Sutea can experience something normal for once. Right…?
episodes.title: The School Festival at Seikan Women's University

episodes.synopsis: Kiriya’s family always throws a Christmas party for their dojo, but this year she’ll have to run it all by herself! Can Koushi and Atena help her spread some holiday cheer?
episodes.title: Kiriya Wishes Upon a Christmas

episodes.synopsis: A kotatsu brings warmth into the household… warmth and shenanigans, that is. Will Kouichi be able to break free of the kotatsu’s cozy clutches?
episodes.title: Sutea Reflects on the Kotatsu / Koushi Tackles Spring Cleaning

episodes.synopsis: When Koushi falls ill just before New Year’s, the dorm residents must rally to nurse him back to health… but their efforts may do more harm than good.
episodes.title: The Goddesses of the Goddess Dormitory
